description: Credit one invoice: the whole invoice, a GROSS amount_minor split over its VAT rates, or named lines. Amounts store negative, reusing the invoice's own rates. Free: 5 a month. Send it with credit_note_text.

amount_minor.description: Credit this GROSS amount, VAT included, in minor units. Split across the invoice's VAT rates in proportion to each rate's share of the total

invoice.description: The invoice number to credit, e.g. INV-2026-0001

issue_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in your business profile's timezone

lines.description: Credit only these invoice lines. Leave out with amount_minor for a full credit note

line.description: 1-based position of the line on the invoice, as shown by invoice_get

quantity.description: Credit only this many units. Defaults to the whole line

notes.description: Free text printed under the totals

reason.description: Why the money is being given back, e.g. "returned goods" or "billed twice". Printed on the document

name: credit_note_create
title: Credit an invoice
